title: AI Product Lab agent evaluation report
description: Schema v1.1 adds a required provenance block. A published verdict that cannot state when it ran, against which commit, on which grader model, and whether author/grader separation held is not citable evidence. Unknown provenance must be recorded as an explicit null plus an explanation in provenance_note — never omitted and never invented.

run_date.description: UTC date the grading run was performed, YYYY-MM-DD. For a run reconstructed after the fact, use the commit date that published it and say so in provenance_note.

repo_commit.description: Short or full SHA of the repository state the run was graded against.

grader_model.description: Model identifier that produced the per-axis verdicts, or the alias configured for the grader subagent. Explicit null means the model was not recorded at capture time; provenance_note must then say so, and the run must not be cited as a reliability claim.

author_grader_separation.description: True only when every axis was graded in a context isolated from the one that authored the session, per protocol.md. False means separation did not hold and the run is a worked example, not evidence.

provenance_note.description: Plain-language statement of how the run was produced and what its provenance does not establish. Required, and must explain any null above.
